scripts.generate: yarn generate-recently-updated && yarn generate-search-index && yarn generate-taxonomy-filter && yarn generate-synteny-accessions && yarn generate-ortholog-index && yarn generate-synteny-pair-index
scripts.prebuild: yarn clean && yarn generate-taxonomy && yarn generate
scripts.predev: aws s3 sync s3://jbrowse.org/processedHubJson/ processedHubJson/ && yarn generate
scripts.sync: tar -czf - -C dist . | ssh myserver 'rm -rf /var/www/html/* && tar -xzf - -C /var/www/html' && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E12EBG02P68TDO --paths '/*'
scripts.sync:staging: tar -czf - -C dist . | ssh myserver 'rm -rf /var/www/staging/* && tar -xzf - -C /var/www/staging' && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E3IPPUV528KQIX --paths '/*'
